Br.</ls> .²3 The collective body of the Ṛgveda (<ab>pl.</ab>), ऋचः सामानि जज्ञिरे <ls>Rv. 10. 90. 9</ls>. ऋक्साम यजुरेव च <ls>Bg. 9. 17</ls>. .²4 Splendour (for रुच्). .²5 Praise. .²6 worship.
